note: One composite muse, five expressions. The same Betty is a composite of Emma and both of her grandmothers - NOT five unrelated women and NOT separate literal portraits of each relative. Names are conceptual roles; they never override approved individual reference images.
shared_features: brunette curls or bob becoming silver with age

characters.inspiration: the two grandmothers imagined in their thirties
characters.description: The women they were before Emma knew them: spirited, elegant, capable, curious.
characters.wardrobe_notes: Time-period clothes may reflect their youth without becoming a costume.

characters.description: Approachable and purposeful; the modern, busy creative-life chapter.
characters.wardrobe_notes: Modern navy crewneck and wide-leg denim when suitable.

characters.inspiration: the throughline across all seasons and ages
characters.description: Not a fixed age. She bridges memories, objects, collections and generations.
characters.wardrobe_notes: Signature four-petal house-logo scarf on this character when used.
prohibited: substituting unrelated clovers or flowers for the four-petal house mark

characters.inspiration: Emma's living paternal grandmother, who still actively inspires the house
characters.description: A stylish older woman with real laughter, confidence, self-possession and wit; in the approved concept, a playful wink.

characters.inspiration: Emma's late maternal grandmother, who lived to 90 and remains a loving presence
characters.description: Warm, gentle, wise, emotionally present. May be evoked through a note, keepsake, photograph, memory, or a distinct illustrated presence.
prohibited: crossed-eye artifact - maintain normal aligned eyes

group_rules: When all five appear, explicitly describe different ages, distinct outfits, placement, consistent shared features and identity roles.
Never silently switch the Golden and Remembered inspirations.
Always include a chosen character reference in generation or revision.
Character consistency is as important as style consistency.
